resources.string: Type a letter to jump to the next item starting with it. Home and End jump to the first and last item.
Purpose. This text only exists to give the full screen dialog enough content to scroll.
Navigation. Type a letter to jump to the next paragraph starting with it, or press End to reach the Close button.
Layout. Any view hierarchy works: the dialog walks every visible view that has a label.
Dismissal. Press Close or Back to return to the previous screen.
